structured.answer: Maybe worth looking into: it's the S&P 500, the fee is a tiny 0.07% and it's up a lot (+857% since 2010, +73% in 5 years). But one unit costs 705 euro and there's a warning that I might not even be able to buy it where I live, so I have no idea how to do it with 300–500 ₪ a month.

'may not be eligible for acquisition in your country of residence', with no explanation of what that means for me
